summary: Norton Implants has over 35 years of experience, about 10,000 implants placed and a WhatsApp number. The homepage hides that proof behind grey placeholders and sends every booking link to one page.

findings.problem: The Testimonials, Publications and Lecture dates tiles use empty grey placeholders, and no reviews or cases appear on the page.
findings.cost: A patient choosing an implant surgeon looks for proof. Grey boxes where the proof should be tell them there is none.
findings.fix: Real testimonials, publications and captioned before and after cases in place of the placeholders.

findings.problem: There is no booking or enquiry form on the page. Every booking link goes to the same page, and there is no live chat.
findings.cost: Every extra click costs consultations, and a patient who wants to ask a quick question has nowhere to do it on the page.
findings.fix: A short booking form on the page, with WhatsApp beside it.

findings.problem: Lecture Diaries in the menu links to #, Read More links to an anchor that may not exist, and the Book your consultation link has a stray space in its address.
findings.cost: Broken links lose visitors and a booking link that may fail loses consultations directly.
findings.fix: Tested links, with every booking button going to a working form.

findings.problem: The phone number and address repeat in the header, body and footer, the menu appears twice, and social icons have no labels.
findings.cost: Repeated blocks dilute a clear message and weaken credibility.
findings.fix: One clean layout with consistent descriptions of each doctor.

redesign: A proof first homepage that uses your 35 years and 10,000 implants, with real testimonials and cases beside every booking button.
A booking form on the page and WhatsApp for quick questions.
